text.p: Louisiana-Pacific Corp said Friday it has completed its previously announced acquisition of GreenStone Industries Inc.

GreenStone shareholders will receive $5.25 per share in cash. Certain members of GreenStone's management and other founding stockholders will receive restricted Louisiana-Pacific common stock instead of cash.

Louisiana-Pacific said in a statement that GreenStone, a maker of cellulose insulation and specialty cellulose fibers, will operate as a wholly owned Louisiana-Pacific subsidiary and will continue to be headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland.
Louisiana-Pacific is a building products company headquartered in Portland with manufacturing facilities throughout the United States and in Canada and Ireland.
